notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition | Public Beta of a New Patch!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

Thanks to your reports, we have isolated yet another nest of pesky intergalactic bugs. We believe we have exterminated them fully, but one can never be sure - and so, to be on the safe side, we are first rolling out this update as a [b]public beta[/b] in a special beta branch, and if it proves stable, we’ll update the game for everyone. That’s why your feedback is even more crucial now – so please, check out the beta branch and storm those [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] and our [url=https://discord.gg/2MDuXJyZGg]Discord server[/url] with your reports!

To access the beta, head to your [i]Steam Library[/i], right-click [i]The Pegasus Expedition[/i], left-click [i]Properties[/i], left-click [i]Betas[/i], and from the [i]drop-down menu[/i], select the option “[i]beta - Test builds for further patches[/i].” Your game will then update to the pre-final version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39915455/606e4cc04db111041584d28eaefd0fcaf6c1d370.png[/img]

The update fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*] Destroy Inoa Quest could be received even if the Inoa has been destroyed.
[*] Biomass Campaign could not start correctly.
[*] In specific circumstances, a storyline could lead to an infinite loop at chapter 5 start.
[/list]

We can’t wait to hear from you! And as always, if you enjoy The Pegasus Expedition, please, consider leaving the game a [i][b]positive review[/b][/i]; it truly makes a [u]huge[/u] difference, and helps us support it with further updates.

notes.title: Warning Signs Hotfix is Out Now
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

A week ago, we published [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1521070/announcements/detail/526461473225966399?snr=2___]a brand-new patch called Warning Signs along with obtainable community items[/url]. The patch fixed numerous issues but still needed a hotfix, so here we are, serving it to you. Besides other things, the Clear Biomass button should now work as intended, thank you all for noticing and reporting the problem!

If there's anything else you'd like to report or if you simply need help with progressing through the game, don't hesitate to [url=https://discord.gg/SyjSK7qcfr]join our Discord[/url], we'll be happy to help!


[h3][b]Change Log:[/b][/h3]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clear Biomass -button was hidden when needed.
[*] Transit Station and Supply Hub build time was filled in the tooltip.
[*] Tech affecting Factory Power Consumption was not initialized right. Now the tech name is showing correctly.
[*] A Derelict room (Xenobiology 2) had a missing localization line.
[*] Double clicking a combat button in 1 vs 1 combat mode leads to double load of the combat.
[*] Fleet arriving late showed Conflict dialog on Combat for a short amount of time.
[*] Post Combat notification about happiness loss had a typo and was shown even if the effect was a lower than rounding error.
[*] Esc -button didn’t fully work as intended.
[*] Human Cultures are listed only once now.
[*] Open conflicts allowed opening a diplomacy dialog. Now it is prevented.
[*] Probability to the friendly quest star system having 3 friendly fleets is now decreased. Not fully preventable.
[*] A typo in the Ankhorum population tag.
[*] The Hire Officer tutorial is replaced by the Hire Admiral Button tutorial that was not earlier used.
[*] Fleet Command Complex flagship construction was not enabled in the right way.
[*] System nameplate shows while Derelict Investigation was about to start.
[/list]

notes.title: Warning Signs Patch and Community Items Are Live Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

Thanks to your watchful eyes and ears, we were able to locate and subsequently fix some obnoxious issues that plagued humanity in the Pegasus galaxy. The patch is called Warning Signs and it's ready for you to download! Full Change Log can be found below.

And since we want to show our gratitude to you, our beloved community, who even now still plays and supports our game, we're also adding plenty of community items to Steam, such as [b]Trading Cards[/b], [b]Profile Backgrounds[/b], [b]Emoticons[/b] and [b]Badges[/b]. Some of these can be earned naturally by playing the game or traded with other Directors, and some can be bought for Steam points on the Steam market. You can check examples below the article.

That's it for today! If there's still something that bothers you in the game or if you simply want to share your feelings about it, come join our [url=https://discord.gg/SyjSK7qcfr]Discord[/url] where we'll happily help you!


[h3][b]Change Log:[/b][/h3]

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Provides additional info for the first turn to better indicate what the player must do.
[*] Adds a General Health Warning at the start of the game. The text is in English or Russian for now.
[*] Camera rotation will be saved. The default value will be used for the first launch.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Adds a construction power symbol in a side value in the star tooltip.
[*] Adds a construction power symbol and amount in the unit tooltip before construction and during construction.
[*] Fixes units construction where units cost more than 1 construction power to manufacture(Tier 2 and 3) in the case where it takes more than one turn to build all of them. Construction was ticking all units in the sequence as long as construction power lasted and visual shows how many turns it takes if the construction was prioritized.
[*] Adds a control logic to future-proof some story changes.
[*] Fixes a story encounter where a faction tries to spawn in the area of the defeated faction.
[*] Fixes a problem where the presence of a Governor (Occupier) didn't prevent rebellions.
[/list]

[h3][b]Community Items[/b][/h3]

[b]Trading Cards[/b]

notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition | Happi, Happi,… After Touch Patch is LIVE
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

Not long ago we have released a big [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1521070/view/4462598034266521629]Happiness Update[/url], but there are some issues that slipped through. Fortunately, we have our diligent community and you managed to catch those bugs, making it possible for us to squish them!

New Features:
- Drag and drop units in the player fleets now works without movement restriction. Previously both fleets must have been unmoved before the unit transfer. Just keep in mind that moving a unit to or from a garrison fleet is not allowed.
- We have added a small frame color animation to dragging and dropping units, to indicate if it was a success or failure.
- Now players are informed of the unknown video error and can use ESC to return to the main menu. In some cases, this could be caused by the Vertical Sync “Fast” option set via GPU Control Panel; so now a message is also displayed informing you of alternate options.
 
Bug Fixes:
- Destroying a structure from another culture could lead to notification with a wrong key displayed.
- A player's production is now updated when a manual save is loaded.
- Fixed a typo in Spy In the high command chain.
- Fixed a bug causing wrong display of notifications when loading a saved game.
- A star system indicator will no longer remain red after a battle was resolved in computer players' turn.
- The remaining time of fleet repairs can no longer be a negative number.
- Vsync uses a slightly different implementation now, which should fix various issues.

Huge thanks to all who keep giving us feedback about the game - and if you have anything to report, suggest or just want to chat, you are cordially invited to join our [url=https://discord.gg/SyjSK7qcfr]Discord server[/url]; or, of course, we always monitor the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url] as well. And if you enjoy the game and want to truly support us, leave a positive [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/reviews/?p=1&browsefilter=toprated]review[/url] here on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition | Happi, Happi, … Happiness Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

We do not intend to leave anyone behind in the Pegasus Galaxy, and so once again, based on the feedback you've shared with us on our [url=https://discord.gg/SyjSK7qcfr]Discord server[/url] and in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url], we have prepared a rather significant update, which is live now!

This patch brings big changes to the Happiness mechanic, which will make it both more impactful, and easier to manage; but there are many more new and changed features, as well as bugfixes - check out the full change log below. We hope that you like the update; we will do our best to keep fixing any further issues you report.

In order to be able to do that though, we have a favor to ask: If you enjoy the game, leave it a positive [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/reviews/?p=1&browsefilter=toprated]review[/url] here on Steam, or, if you've marked it as "not recommended" in the past and your reasons have since been fixed by our updates, please consider changing your review. Of course, negative reviews are absolutely a legitimate way of voicing your criticism, but they don't allow for the follow-up discussion and clarification that we may need to actually improve the game; not to mention, they [b]hurt[/b] the sales and visibility of the game on Steam. That is why we would like to ask you to not take them lightly.

And now, without further ado, enjoy the Happi, Happi, … Happiness Update!

[h2]Full Change Log[/h2]
[h3]New/Updated Features:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Switching from Global Happiness to Local Happiness model.
[*] Added a new happiness heat map to show on the grand map.
[*] Making Happiness changes more visible to the player.
[*] Making sources of Extra Production more visible to the player.
[*] Highlighting a selected item on Overview.
[*] Hiding Station Construction View when Planetary Construction View is open.
[*] Adding Pegasus Biomaterial Study and Shipboard Laboratories production to the science tooltip to be more visible to the player.
[*] A campaign starting video has been slowed by 33% to make its texts easier to read.
[*] Colony Slots are marked as III -sign.
[*] Adding unit construction enablers and construction power to Tier 2 and Tier 3 structures.
[*] Adding unit construction power requirements by their tier.
[*] Speeding up AI turns by optimizing resource usage.
[*] Random events Income that scales with player resources has a randomized minimum amount.
[*] Tech tree focuses on the most prioritized tech when opened.
[*] The most prioritized tech is visible on the top bar. 
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Random loot from combat cannot have a 0 amount of one of the resources anymore.
[*] Memory requirements for loading a game where a player owns a large portion of the galaxy are now lower.
[*] Gifting systems while repairing fleets used to get those fleets stuck - not anymore.
[*] Nanobots tech used to refer to wrong structures; now they do to the correct ones.
[*] The Production Management Bureau - its effect did not reduce costs of the units, it now does correctly.
[*] A Upgrade - button of a unit could be visible, but the new unit could not be constructed. Now the button is only visible when the construction is possible.
[*] Advanced Greenhouses - the tech had no effect on outposts due to a bug, it now correctly affects outposts as well.
[*] A tooltip was referring to the "Tab" key, while it’s actually the "Q" key - the tooltip has been fixed.
[*] Alert level of the factions was not stored properly, it is now.
[*] Derelict Quests could prevent the game from continuing - this potentially gamebreaking bug is now fixed.
[*] The displayed number of Defensive Satellites did not always show the correct amount. It does now.

notes.title: Last Early Access Content Update - The Exodus - Is Live!
notes.notes:
Greetings Directors,
We have officially entered the final stretch before full launch of The Pegasus Expedition - the last of the scheduled major Content Updates is here!

The Exodus is a new scenario bringing a serious twist to the traditional 4X gameplay; in it, the galaxy is being consumed by the unstoppable Biomass and all you can do is delay the inevitable. Your mission has failed, humanity is doomed, all you can do is run and survive for as long as you can. Fun, right?

But of course, the new scenario is not the only addition to the game. Most importantly, the combat system has undergone a complete overhaul and now you will have much more control over the strategy your fleets employ, along with an update to the tutorial reflecting that. 

The galaxy is changing significantly as well, with an update to the galaxy generation, meaning that individual star systems will be more specialized in terms of resource production, reinforcing the importance of planning your colonies and structures, as well as the targets for your conquest.

And to make building your colonies up, there is a new Filtering feature, making it much easier to find the buildings you want.

But wait, there's more... Check out the complete changelog below! And if you like the new changes, consider leaving the game a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/reviews/]Steam review[/url], or come chat to the developers on their [url=https://discord.gg/GnRDhUXzBV]Discord server[/url]!

[h2]Complete changelog:[/h2]

[h3]Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The way galactic perception is changed to more directly reflect players' actions and will now also much more directly affect how the Other factions will view the player.
[*] AI will now prioritize building higher tier fleets as well as research technologies more actively in aim to keep them better on par with the player. Other miscellaneous AI tweaks have also been implemented, and this is not intended to be the final state of the AI but a step in the correct direction. 
[/list]
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where combat music would not play
[*] Fixed an issue where texts won't align with their buttons
[*] Fixed an issue where fleets would not lose combat power from lost ships 
[*] Fixed an issue where the cancel button would not work with operations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the council screen could “blink” as black
[*] Fixed an issue where the player wouldn't receive the story-related operative 
[*] Fixed an issue where derelicts could stay active after exploration. 
[*] Fixed missing tooltips relating to global interrupts. 
[*] Fixed an issue where game could lock up on ending the turn 
[*] Fixed an issue where Pegasus republics production numbers would not show.
[*] Many miscellaneous small fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: The third Content Update "The Height of The Empire" is here!
notes.notes:
Greetings Directors,

Allow us to introduce the third Content Update for The Pegasus Expedition, [b]The Height of The Empire[/b]! In this new scenario, the Tamanin Empire stays unified against you, unlike in the main narrative campaign where it experiences a civil war and splinters into several smaller factions. You will have to face fierce opposition from them and be thrust into war immediately!

That's not all however, we have introduced a plethora of new features and changes based on your feedback. Among the highlights are an overhaul to the story consequences system, giving you a much clearer idea of how your choices impact the campaign; a brand new Veterancy system, which will make sure your units will improve their performance when they survive through many battles; a new governing tool, the Edicts, which will give you additional control over the happiness of your subjects and a new devastating option has been added to your arsenal, you can now use Thermonuclear weapons to turn the tide of battle, but incur a massive reputation penalty.

But there's more, check out the full list of changes below and don't forget to let us know what you think in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]Steam discussions[/url] or ask the developers directly on their [url=https://discord.com/invite/VjCcaxNA3U][b]Discord server[/b][/url]. notes.title: Scattered Empires Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

As we outlined in our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/0/3392923906941683212/]Early Access Roadmap[/url], we will soon be releasing the first Content Update for The Pegasus Expedition. It doesn't bring any major changes to the main story campaign (even though we will be squashing multiple bugs with it), the main event of the release is a brand new way to play the game: [b]Scenarios[/b]!

A scenario differs from the main story campaign in that it lacks the narrative structure, has different objectives and very different settings. The first scenario we are introducing is called [i][b]Scattered Empires[/b][/i] - it will find your intrepid expedition at a randomized starting location in the Pegasus Galaxy, with the objective to build 6 Arges Facilities in 6 different colonies. All gameplay mechanics and features are of course in place as you know them from the main campaign, you are free to explore, colonize, research and wage war throughout the galaxy as you see fit, in a more traditional sandbox 4X experience. And do not worry, all future improvements and new features will of course apply to all scenarios as well.

That is not all however - unlike in the story campaign, in scenarios you can pick different playable factions. With [i][b]Scattered Empires[/b][/i], we are introducing the 4 human fleets to choose from, each with varying advantages and disadvantages, significantly affecting your playstyle and gameplay experience. More will come during Early Access, stay tuned!

We greet you again, Directors,

Thanks to you and your ongoing feedback we were able to locate and address more issues in the Pegasus galaxy. So there's nothing to wait for, update your game and enjoy the improved gameplay!

Early Access is partially about tweaking and polishing the game as much as possible, so, please, keep doing what you're doing, provide us with that feedback, point out those issues and let us know about them here on Steam or on our [url=https://discord.gg/GnRDhUXzBV]Discord server[/url], we will be happy to hear from you!

And if you like The Pegasus Expedition, consider giving us a [b]positive review[/b] here on Steam, it really does help, not only by boosting our confidence!

[h3][b]Changes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Changes to the Attack on Anabah quest: There is now a timer of 15 turns, and if the player doesn't succeed, the Empire has her fleets readied and will start an extremely strong offensive. Succeeding within those 15 turns is recommended.
[*] Changes to the Tamanin Empire behaviour: The Empire can commence few smaller military operations even before the point when their mobilization is ready. Previously they would be very passive despite having just declared war.
[*] Station combat power will now be shown in the pre-combat view so that the player knows their impact to the battle.
[*] Small changes to the starmap around Yksae system of the Ror-clan to make their territory more defendable.
[*] The Portal fleet is now called "The Second Portal",  its sprite has been updated, and its location is shown as a beam in order to differentiate it from normal fleets.
[*] Changed description of the quest Final Push to make it clearer what the player is expected to do.
[*] Hanoar Clique will now have defense stations on its own territory, to give them a more fair chance.
[*] The Portal "star" on the map had it's sprite updated to match its appearance elsewhere
[*] Nemesis fleets have been renamed to Nemesis fleets, instead of normal naming system
[/list]

[h3][b]Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed some missing localization lines
[*] Denying a protectorate proposal could lead to the same faction proposing it over and over
[*] Player wasn't always able to build Tier 3 ships properly, and in proper quantities
[*] The end game quest involving the foothold in N214R could get stuck and block progression, it has been fixed
[*] Hiring a governor when there were only human options could still lower reputation
[*] Decontamination will clear stations properly, earlier the infestation could remain
[*] Language selector supports widescreen
[*] Fixed a bug where AI turn could last forever
[*] The stars in a late game location called Test-1, Test-2 etc. are now named properly
[*] Some technology prices were incorrect, they have been fixed.
[*] Defend against the Hanoar Offensive - quest could be shown twice, leaving the second one active forever even after completion.
[/list]

notes.title: Another update for The Pegasus Expedition!
notes.notes:
Greetings Directors,

The Pegasus Expedition has been swimming in the Early Access waters for two weeks now. During that time, many of you were able to play the game and provided us with a lot of feedback, which we are really grateful for!

Indeed, this update focuses on changing / fixing / tweaking things that you, our dearest community, pointed out. Please, keep doing that, it really helps us make The Pegasus Expedition a game all of you can enjoy as much as possible - so go on, give us more tips and suggestions so we can improve it further!

Here are some perfect places where to do that: [url=https://discord.gg/GnRDhUXzBV]Kalla Gameworks Discord server[/url], [url=https://discord.gg/FulqrumPublishing]Fulqrum Publishing Discord server[/url], [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]The Pegasus Expedition Steam forums[/url]. Also don't forget to write a review of the game if you like it, it helps more than you may think.

[b][h2]Changes:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] Improved optimisation of GPU usage and performance.
[*] The start of the game has been made a little easier by giving the player more starting resources and reinforcements, and adjusting the Ror Clan AI.
[*] Capturing territory from the Hanoar Clique right after it spawned was too easy, they now have their fleets ready earlier.
[*] Transit stations and their tutorialisation have been moved further into the campaign from the start, as they are unnecessary in the beginning.
[*] Visual distinction between a harvestable asteroid belt and a non-harvestable asteroid belt has been made clearer.
[*] The Tamanin Empire was able to declare war very quickly after diplomatic contact even if the player hadn't acted aggressively. They will now wait longer if the player doesn’t provoke them.
[/list]

[b][h2]Fixes:[/h2][/b]

[list]
[*] The player was able to end their turn before their first move in the campaign, they now need to make their first move.
[*] Removing a Supply hub didn’t remove the energy price correctly, that has been fixed.
[*] Upgrading a settlement to a colony would not correctly be counted in the quest counter.
[*] Fixed a possible freeze in Maelstyrakh sidequest, and a false notification telling the players allies refused an alliance they actually did not refuse.
[*] Station Construction and Repair could become available earlier than intended.
[*] The first Galactic Reputation pop-up could come up too early.
[*] Saving and then loading could deplete a fleet’s movement points if located in foreign territory.
[/list]

That's it for today! If you have not played The Pegasus Expedition yet, go ahead and try the DEMO. It's completely free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1521070/The_Pegasus_Expedition/

notes.title: The Pegasus Expedition receives new patch and brand new DEMO!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Directors!

A week has gone by since the launch of The Pegasus Expedition and it's time for us to serve you the first update! Thanks to your feedback, which we are very thankful for, we have been able to locate and fix multiple issues, including those game-breaking ones. Now it's your turn to enjoy the game! Read the full change log below.

We are also putting up new DEMO version so everyone could try the game for free! This DEMO has been put together from the current version of the game and is much more enjoyable than the previous one, so feel free to give it a go!

Nothing to wait for, go play The Pegasus Expedition, [url=https://discord.gg/GnRDhUXzBV]join the developers' Discord server[/url] where you can chat about the game, report any issues you find and enjoy your time with the community! Also don't forget to [url=https://linktr.ee/fulqrumpublishing]follow the Social Media of Fulqrum Publishing[/url] to keep up with all the important news!

If you like the game, we would be really happy if you dropped a review of it here on Steam. It helps more than you think!


[b][h3]Change log:[/h3][/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Made Ror clan more passive at the start of the game (Requires new game)
[*] Repair has been made somewhat cheaper and the duration has been capped to 6 turns
[*] Adjusted the behaviour of the Daras-faction, which has been acting too expansively (affects only New Game, not existing saves)
[*] The game now uses Steam Cloud saving system
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fix to a black screen crash issue affecting especially older machines and computers with Windows 7
[*] Hotfix for a bug with "Foothold secured in N214R galaxy" which blocked some players' progress. (affects only saves from before receiving the troublesome quest) 
[*] Fixed missing subtitles from chapter 2 cutscene
[*] Fixed low happiness affecting resources generation incorrectly [*] Fixed issue of player being able to capture Otokhot, a quest objective for Maelstyrakh Civil war quest too early and the quest not recognizing it. (only for saves from before capturing Otokhot too early)
[*] Fixed that upgrading a structure would often replace a wrong building with the upgraded one, not the one being upgraded. 
[*] Fixed issue of Anabah Movement spawning without war and being friendly. Now they are permanently at war with the player
[*] Fixed an issue with the protectorate event chain not resetting when it should be refused by the player.
[*] Refusing Maelstyrakh Civil War quest would not always remove movement restrictions tied to it.
[/list]

notes.title: The current development priorities and upcoming update(s)
notes.notes:
Greetings Directors,

The Pegasus Expedition, even in its Early Access release form, is quite a complex and long game; this makes finding and fixing bugs challenging, and properly testing fixes a time-consuming process as well. Rest assured we are hard at work and thanks to the amount of information you, our community, have provided (we cannot stress enough how much we appreciate that, please, keep all your feedback coming), we will be releasing a patch fixing many of the following issues in the coming days. 

We believe we have successfully resolved these most critical issues, but testing to make sure everything works properly still takes time, we humbly ask for a little more patience:
[list]
[*] Certain operating system language-related issues that prevented launching a New Game
[*] Operating system and system’s processing-related crash that prevented Launching a New Game
[*] A bug blocking progress for some players in the quest objective “Foothold secured” in a very late part of the game.
[*] “Attack Otokhot” quest objective could remain unfulfilled forever as the game wouldn’t notice the player had conquered it in an earlier part of the quest.
[*] Low happiness penalties were often regarded as bonuses, instead of penalties
[*] The Ror clan was too powerful and aggressive in the very beginning of the game. They will now take a bit longer to recover from the initial shock of the player's arrival, and the player will begin with a bit stronger force.
[*] Upgrade button would sometimes remove the wrong building to replace with the upgraded building.
[*] Rebalancing the Repair system, there is now a 6-turn max cap for repair time, and missile salvos and strategic weapons will now have a cheaper refill price.
[/list]

We are also working on slightly less serious issues and bugs, which might come in a separate patch a few days later:
[list]
[*] Anabah Movement could appear without declaring war, causing unintended situations.
[*] Daras acted very aggressively and expansively, often contrary to their intended behaviour. Their behaviour has been enhanced to be more in line with their declared intentions.
[*] Daras would also get their fleets stuck in ex-Tamanin Empire territory, they no longer will venture there too early.
[*] Refusing a certain meeting after the destruction of the Pegasus Republic could result in wrong ending lines.
[*] Fixed some string ID:s showing instead of intended text.
[*] Fixed some typos found in the text.
[/list]

We are also aware of the feedback on tutorials, and we will be making them more fleshed out, with additional visual elements supplementing text. This will however take more than a few days to properly prepare. In the meantime, you can refer to a [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878490590]beginner's guide[/url] we have prepared - let us know if anything in it is still unclear and we can update that much more easily!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2878490590

We are humbled by the interest our game generated, and the amount of feedback we are getting - but we can always use more, please, don't hesitate and post all positive and negative feedback either here on Steam in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1521070/discussions/]the discussions[/url], or on our [url=https://discord.gg/7ZxkukPWKU]Discord server[/url].
